description: Recommend a ranked shortlist of dart games for a given play context (player count, optional difficulty, time budget, and board type). Each recommendation includes a reason, the board it needs (boardType, boardLabel, boardUrl) and its dolfdarts.com URL. Most players have the standard board; when boardType is omitted, standard-board games are ranked first.

boardType.description: The dartboard the players have. Most players have 'standard'; omit to include all 39 board types. Board ids and live game counts: browse_taxonomy (boards). When omitted, standard-board games are ranked first.

playerCount.description: Number of players who will play (required).

name: recommend_games
title: Recommend dart games
